name: Volunteer at the Library
what_you_do: Shelve and sort library items. Sort donated books, help staff and get crafts ready for children's programs.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be 16 or older. Ages 16 and 17 need a parent or guardian signature. Photo ID is required.
deadline_text: Apply any time through a branch.
how_to_apply: Contact the branch you want. Meet the Volunteer Coordinator or Branch Manager. Then send in the Volunteer Application/Agreement. A free fingerprint background check follows.
notes: The page says students can earn community service hours for graduation. The branch manager must approve your spot.
